summary: After Ettin admission, the Sanctum case reaches a demilich death at zero-based step 91. C calls rn2(3) because level_finalize_topology promotes graveyard when has_morgue is set; JavaScript leaves graveyard false, so xkilled skips that undead-graveyard draw and calls rn2(6). The fix belongs in the existing mklev.c:level_finalize_topology port.

source.branch: After special-level fixup and room generation set level.flags.has_morgue, level_finalize_topology must set level.flags.graveyard true and preserve any earlier true value when has_morgue is false. The current v45 Sanctum replay enters mklev() after the Lua level loader has set has_morgue.
callers: C: mklev.c:mklev() calls level_finalize_topology() after makelevel(); the Sanctum Lua load/fill has set has_morgue by then. JavaScript: js/mklev.js:mklev() calls level_finalize_topology() after makelevel().

C: sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level() also calls level_finalize_topology() after fixup_special() and before fill_special_room(). JavaScript: js/mklev.js:lspo_finalize_level() mirrors this source call order.

evidence: Saved combined queue SHA-256 b0094a909ce515982d005e205b4d70f84590cdba10fb14584792217c51e11e26, current against evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-4155c38654a493477fa04e1f3089882aa2110af0-v45.json at 4155c38654a493477fa04e1f3089882aa2110af0. The only candidate is synthetic/v45/v45-offer-real-amulet-sanctum-no-carry-teleport-attempt28-cfirst; it has 155/157 screens and 156/157 cursors matching, and its first mismatch is zero-based segment 0 step 91 on key ".": C rn2(3)=2 at xkilled(mon.c:3574), JS rn2(6)=2.

The C recording identifies the target at step 90 as a demilich and records “You destroy the demilich!” on step 91. nethack-c/upstream/src/mon.c:44-47 defines LEVEL_SPECIFIC_NOCORPSE as rogue-level || !deathdrops || (graveyard && is_undead(mdat) && rn2(3)); xkilled() tests it at line 3574. js/mon.js:5315 implements the same predicate and xkilled() invokes it at line 6026.

A replay of the accepted segment through recorded step 90 yields current level D:20 with JS flags has_morgue=true, graveyard=false, and deathdrops=true. The source-level RNG difference therefore comes from the missing flag transition, not a missing xkilled random call.

nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:1544-1574 implements level_finalize_topology(). Immediately after clearing the Lua coordinate frame, lines 1556-1560 preserve graveyard when has_morgue is true; JavaScript js/mklev.js:8038-8058 currently omits this source branch before topologize() and set_wall_state().

C sets has_morgue from MORGUE rooms in mkroom.c:fill_special_room() and sp_lev.c:fill_special_room(). The active C special-level route runs makelevel() through mklev.c:mklev(), which invokes level_finalize_topology() once room setup has completed; sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level() is the other direct caller and retains its source order. The corresponding JS callers already exist in js/mklev.js.

This is a bounded divergence fix in the existing mklev.c:level_finalize_topology implementation. The source change is to mirror its conditional state promotion; xkilled(), the graveyard predicate, and the existing has_morgue producers are not the defect.
message: Missing has_morgue-to-graveyard promotion changes the demilich death RNG branch.
